replay_method: Fresh temporary workspace for each retained candidate; execute frozen public and held-out assertions using the installed Hermes Python; require successful exit and an end-of-script sentinel.
limitations: Six purpose-made cases, one execution per case, not a representative production workload.
Only the fixed xhigh baseline was executed; no lower-effort counterfactual or causal savings claim.
Verified corrective revisions count failed native verification followed by source changes, not every form of iteration or test development.
The local model reports unknown monetary cost; observed tokens and latency are not provider invoices.
